newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Growth in Brazil exports worries Argentina-paper.
newsitem.headline: Growth in Brazil exports worries Argentina-paper.

text.p: The growth in Brazilian exports to Argentina, which in August virtually closed a two-year-old trade gap between the two countries, is worrying the Buenos Aires government, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.
The paper said the Argentine Economy Ministry's trade, industry and mining secretary, Alieto Guadagni, plans to visit Brasilia next Monday to discuss the issue with Brazilian officials.

He will ask Brazil to end rebates for exports to nations of the Mercosur customs union, suspend government financing for exports to the region and speed deregulation of the Brazilian government's oil sector monopoly, it said.
Alarm was raised in Buenos Aires last weekend, when Brazil released August bilateral trade figures, the paper said.
Argentine numbers are not availale yet but Brazilian exports to its southern neighbor reached $520.2 million, up 41.5 percent from the same month last year, Gazeta said.
The result reduced Brazil's trade deficit with Argentina to just $6 million compared with an average monthly gap of $100 million over the last two years, the paper said.
